prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after waiting screen: Move the sign-in step to occur right after pet generation completes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save your desktop pet to your account"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Placement Preview Screen: Add a new preview screen right before finishing onboarding to demonstrate how the pet lives on the desktop taskbar.
   config: {"new_placement_preview": {"headline": "See how your pet appears on your desktop", "body": "Your pet sits quietly in your taskbar corner. You can drag them anywhere or right-click to hide.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "image", "asset": "asset:desktop_preview", "style": "rounded"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_placement_preview", "home_intro"]}
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Status Checklist Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen layout to a checklist structure showing real-time pet rendering stages.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing your desktop pet", "layout": "checklist", "show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Rendering 3D model, Setting up animations, Enabling desktop interaction", "style": "plain"}]}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Quick Start Preset Adoption Flow: Introduce a fast-track instant adoption action on the pick_friend screen to adopt standard pets without photo uploads.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Pick a companion or create a custom pet", "layout": "two_column", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Instant Adopt Preset Pet", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
4: [home, notification] Completion Sound Notification on Waiting Screen: Play a completion chime and send a system notification when generation finishes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:completion_chime", "style": "plain"}]}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Add a account recovery hint on the sign-in screen explaining pet account synchronization.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your previous account to restore your existing desktop pet profile.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Already created a pet? Sign into your original account to restore pet data.", "style": "subtle"}]}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Compact Layout: Change story screen layout to compact to move users into path choice faster.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Welcome to your new desktop companion"}}
7: [home, wait_info] Time Remaining Countdown Estimate: Display a dynamic time estimate countdown timer on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Estimated preparation time: 2 minutes"}}
8: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Companion Controls Guide Badge: Add an interactive controls guide badge component to the home_intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your pet is now active on your desktop!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Quick Tip: Right-click pet on desktop to open settings or talk", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Guidelines Helper Copy: Update body copy on upload_photos screen with explicit instructions on clear photo lighting and subject framing.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"body": "For best pet generation, upload well-lit photos showing your pet centered and facing forward."}}

verdicts.reason: Moving sign-in within onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4 and all required steps are retained.
Adding a new preview screen within onboarding before home_intro is allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen layout to a checklist still shows the pet is being made.
Adding an instant adoption action on pick_friend maintains the required onboarding flow and step requirements.
Adding completion chime and notifications on the waiting screen is permitted under Rule 4.
Adding account recovery hint copy on the sign-in screen is compliant with all rules.
Changing the story screen layout to compact is allowed as long as it continues to introduce the pet.
Displaying a time estimate countdown during a real wait on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 5.
Adding an interactive guide badge to home_intro is allowed as home_intro is part of onboarding.
Updating helper copy on the photo upload screen is permitted within onboarding.
